slots.question: Which tempo should the move have?
options: *A proper: the loved tempo thirds of the reference move
B calm: slower wind-up, long settle
C aggressive: short wind-up, hard snap

slots.question: What does the character hold?
options: *A The weapon the move's dossier names

slots.question: How much should be animated this round?
options: *A One move, its key poses approved first
B A five-hit combo string after the first move is approved

steps: lune run kit start anim (boot sheet, golden and graveyard pages)
the move dossier: real footage timings and the reference frames of each phase
key poses on a pose sheet beside the dossier's frames; the owner approves the blocking (kit approve anim <name> --stage blocking)
lune run kit anim <Name>: the motion gates (Hit vs speed peak, planted feet, pops, weapon clear) and the LOOK strips
show the owner from the player's camera, then kit verdict anim <name> <0-10> "<their words>"
done_when: lune run kit playtest run anim_layers --studio <id>
kit verdict anim <name> recorded from the owner's words
engine_caps: an animation clip plays on game time
a server-owned NPC's Animator runs on the server
accessory welds follow the limb they are welded to

failure_lexicon.floaty: weight: the pelvis drops 0.30-0.45 studs into the hit, a 3-frame snap hold on contact, planted feet
failure_lexicon.heavy: weight: the pelvis drops 0.30-0.45 studs into the hit, hips turn before shoulders, the blade lags the hands by about 6 frames
failure_lexicon.stiff: overlap: hips before shoulders, shoulders before the hands, a settle after the hit
failure_lexicon.arm: the whole body drives the swing: a step, a crouch, hips before shoulders (never an arm-only swing on stilts)
failure_lexicon.snap: no single-frame spikes: curves are dense 60 fps, the pop gate reads 0
failure_lexicon.slide: planted feet: sole speed 0 while planted
